headline: Imran Khan's party protests in Karachi on 3-year imprisonment anniversary, clashes with police
summary: Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) supporters took to the streets in Karachi to mark three years since former PM Imran Khan's arrest. Clashes erupted with police, who used tear gas and batons, leading to arrests and a chaotic scene.
details: Supporters of Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) held a protest in Karachi to mark the third anniversary of former Prime Minister Imran Khan's imprisonment. The demonstration quickly escalated into chaos as police intervened.

Police attempted to disperse the protesters using tear gas and baton charges, resulting in the arrest of several individuals. In response, protesters threw stones at the police, turning the area into a battlefield.

Despite the police crackdown, PTI supporters regrouped and continued their anti-government chants. Imran Khan has been serving a 14-year sentence since his arrest on August 5, 2023, on corruption charges.

Khan and his party have consistently denied the charges, labeling them as politically motivated. The Pakistani government maintains that the former prime minister's release is subject to the ongoing legal process.

headline_marked: [[Gas pressure normalizes]] after days of disruption; Gold prices surge
headline: Gas pressure normalizes after days of disruption; Gold prices surge
summary: The national grid is receiving gas again after repairs to the Maheshkhali LNG terminal. Meanwhile, domestic gold prices have seen a significant increase.
details: Gas supply to the national grid has resumed following the repair of a fault at the Maheshkhali LNG terminal. This marks an end to days of disruption that affected gas pressure across the country.
The disruption had caused significant inconvenience to households and industries reliant on natural gas. The repair work was completed, allowing for the restoration of normal supply.
In parallel, the price of gold in Bangladesh has experienced a sharp rise. The cost of 22-carat gold per bhori has increased by Tk 9,856, reaching new highs.

This surge in gold prices is attributed to fluctuations in the global market, which has seen a significant increase in the prices of both gold and silver. Analysts are closely watching these international trends.
caption:
Gas supply is back to normal after days of disruption, but gold prices have skyrocketed. 

What's behind these major shifts?

Gas supply to the national grid has resumed following the repair of a fault at the Maheshkhali LNG terminal. This marks an end to days of disruption that affected gas pressure across the country.

The disruption had caused significant inconvenience to households and industries reliant on natural gas. The repair work was completed, allowing for the restoration of normal supply.

In parallel, the price of gold in Bangladesh has experienced a sharp rise. The cost of 22-carat gold per bhori has increased by Tk 9,856, reaching new highs.

This surge in gold prices is attributed to fluctuations in the global market, which has seen a significant increase in the prices of both gold and silver. Analysts are closely watching these international trends.

#Bangladesh #GasSupply #GoldPrice #Economy #News

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Somoy News, Jamuna TV
